notes.title: v0.8.3 - minor balancing fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed incorrect upgrade value on Holy Orb count (8 per upgrade -> 1)
- Fixed incorrect upgrade value on Directional Bullet count (8 per upgrade -> 1)
- Fixed incorrect upgrade value on Holy Shot count (8 per upgrade -> 1)
- Fixed incorrect initial damage value on Holy Orb (1 -> 4)
- Fixed incorrect initial damage value on Holy Shot (2 ->10)
- Shield activates much faster, and activates on both grow and shrink
- Shield now deals 1 damage to everything it hits
- Laser now deals much less damage, but ticks twice as fast
- EXP orbs move towards kaz slightly faster

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.7.5 - MORE Mortal Abilities!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes v0.7.5 - MORE Mortal Abilities![/h1]  
Hello, @Cult Members🪽 (Haphazard Angel)!  
The heavens tremble as we unveil divine chaos in the latest playtest build.  

**Here’s what’s new in this update:**  
---  
[b]✨ New Features[/b]  
[list]  
[*][b]Pride Ability:[/b] Roar to push away objects, including essences  
[*][b]Greed Ability:[/b] Pulls objects towards the wing, including spikes  
[*][b]Envy Ability:[/b] Silences all wings except Envy for 5 seconds  
[*][b]Gluttony Ability:[/b] Consumes all objects in a small area  
[*][b]Lust Ability:[/b] Moves kazfiel towards the essence (beware of obstacles!!!)  
[*][b]Wrath Ability:[/b] Destroys everything in front of the wing (including essences)  
[*][b]Sloth Ability:[/b] Creates a vortex that pulls everything toward the center. Including you.  
[/list]  

[b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Updated controller for UI  
[*]Added play again button to all win/lose screens  
[*]Updated Laser VFX  
[*]Fixed bug when people join while in lobby  
[/list]  

[b]⚖️ Balancing[/b]  
[list]  
[*]You now have to be an evil wing to use abilities.  
[*]You only need one evil essence to turn into an evil wing  
[*]Using an ability reverts you into a normal wing  
[/list]  

[b]🕒 Up Next[/b]  
[list]  
[*]New SFX!  
[*]Sneak peek on story mode!  
[*]

notes.title: v0.5.0 - Immovable Pillars, Emotes, Shield Sync, and Evil Wing Powers Update
notes.content:
Hello, Kazfiel's Wings! We got a pretty big update on the loose!

Here’s what’s new in this update:  

---

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-  Several UI state fixes
- Reworked lobby and wing selection UI
- Fixed Steam Avatar incorrect when you connect game controllers in a different timing

---

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
-  Increased base speed and torque of wings
- Reworked animation timing for shield sync
- Essences no longer spawn next to each other
- Getting hit when you have evil essence will no longer kill wing
- Rocks no longer continues pushing after collision

---

[h1]New Features  [/h1]
- Added immovable pillars system
- Added 6 pillar designs, randomly selected during gameplay
- Added flap mechanic on lobby to help check if you're already connected 
- Added settings 
- Added pause menu
- Added multipliers when wing is in evil mode
- Emotes added
---
[h1]Up Next  [/h1]
- Game BGM integration.  
- More wing sync mechanics

---

[h1]Playtest Expansion[/h1]
We’re opening **5 more playtest keys** with this patch! Dive in and help us push the limits—break the game, report bugs, and share your feedback!  

Thank you for your support and love! :blue_heart:  
— @Capriccioso:rocket:
